evidence.P1: Becoming the One ev-032 cites Morpheus capture as cause but capture ev-025/ev-031 absent from that chain, and ev-004->ev-016 and ev-020->ev-045 in Matrix Itself are and-then without same-plot enablement
evidence.P2: Each plot maintains one stance - Becoming the One on Identity choice, Believer on Faith vs proof, Love on love-as-faith, Crew on Freedom vs control, Matrix Itself on Truth vs lie - without retelling another plot's summary
evidence.P3: Becoming the One omits ev-011 Born Into the Real World and ev-012 Waking and Rebuilding which earn place in identity death/rebirth, and Crew omits early recruitment ev-007/ev-008 while padding is minimal
evidence.P4: All plots show setup-turn-resolution - Becoming the One from ev-004 white-rabbit summons to ev-045 halting bullets to ev-047 flight, Believer from ev-014 search is over to ev-045 declaration of the One, Love from ev-004 singling out to ev-044 kiss-revival to ev-047 vigil break - nothing dangling
evidence.P5: Events ev-014, ev-016, ev-045 recur across Becoming the One, Believer and Love but reframed through distinct dilemmas (identity vs faith vs love) and Crew vs Matrix Itself split objective insurgency vs societal lie rather than rehashing

raw.commentary: Hard marking: P1 fails on same-plot causality with gaps requiring external capture/trap events; P2-P5 hold with disciplined perspectives, mostly accurate membership despite missing birth/rebuild beats, complete arcs, and non-redundant reframing of shared events.
